title: Sidebar Quick Notes
description: Keep your thoughts organized with persistent notes that sync across projects

title: Sip Squad: Water Reminder
description: A squad of heroes takes turns dropping into your editor and stays until you drink your water. Waits until you stop typing, counts your glasses in the status bar.

title: Terminal Any Encoding
description: Use non-UTF-8 character encodings (Windows-1252, ISO-8859-1, Windows-1251, KOI8-R, Shift JIS, EUC-JP, GBK, Big5, EUC-KR, and the rest of the 45 non-Unicode encodings VS Code natively supports) in the VS Code integrated terminal.

title: Terminal Color Cycle
description: Every new terminal gets the next color in a rotation, so terminals are easy to tell apart.

title: gitSt8
description: One view for advanced git workflows: graph history, search, fetch/prune, branch, merge, rebase (incl. interactive), stacks, worktrees, tags, reflog undo, compare and diff.

title: BlastCode - Code Graph & MCP Companion
description: Code-graph engine, live workspace caretaker, and blast-radius analysis companion for AI agents in VS Code and Cursor

title: Altrobyte AI Trainer
description: A hands-on lab instructor inside VS Code: it watches your real setup (PlatformIO, board, serial, MQTT), teaches without doing the work for you, and verifies every milestone with real checks.

title: ASMC Support
description: Support the custom ASM Craft language.

title: FMCuttingBoard
description: Move FileMaker objects (scripts, fields, tables, layouts, custom functions, value lists) between FileMaker's clipboard and editable fmxmlsnippet XML.
